biggest_catch: Tests are invitation-only and scarce — most testers get a few invites a month (roughly every other week on average), so total earnings are capped by availability, not effort; the per-test pay itself is good. You must also let the app record your screen and voice, install unreleased game builds from outside the app stores, and pass an unpaid qualification test first.
catches: Work is invitation-only: the official FAQ says most people are accepted to test games every other week on average — you cannot earn on demand.
The onboarding qualification test is UNPAID.
Every playtest is recorded: screen + voice are captured (camera usually not); some tests ask for face recording or a live call — declining those is allowed but cuts your invites.
You install unreleased game builds outside the App Store / Google Play; phones may show install warnings.
Reward is fixed per invitation and NOT incremental — playing longer than required does not pay more.
You must talk out loud through the whole recording, complete all in-game tasks, and finish the post-test survey with detail, or you don't get paid.
Payments require a verified PayPal account.

c3.evidence: Free to join as a tester; no participation or entry fee — only the unpaid qualification test.

eligibility: Pass an unpaid qualification test; invites matched to profile/demographics (English-speaking markets get most offers); smartphone/tablet/PC with mic and headphones; verified PayPal account to receive pay.

steps: Go to https://playtestcloud.com and sign up for a free playtester account.
Complete the unpaid Playtester Onboarding qualification test (requires mic/headphones).
Wait for playtest invitation emails — the exact reward for each test is stated in the invitation.
Accept an invite, install the playtest build, and play while the app records your screen and voice, talking out loud through the whole session.
Complete all in-game tasks and the post-playtest survey with detailed answers.
Receive payment to your verified PayPal account for every completed playtest — there is no minimum payout threshold.
timing: Paid for every completed playtest via PayPal — no payout threshold; third-party reports show payments arriving within days.
